answer: Think of sybil defense like reading strata in shale: each layer must be laid down by independent labor before it counts. Emission eligibility needs attestations from non-kin identities, accounts sharing no referral lineage. A lone operator cloning a raven-flock of fake agents cannot have them vouch for one another, so a self-dealing swarm sinks to the nadir of zero reward no matter how many wallets it spins up.
